reference_role: NEW reproducible pilot reference; not the historical sync source

policy.selection: For each move use all L levels from its latest available generation; retain older-generation-only moves. Not a strict SV dex.
policy.tie_order: Source learnset property order, then move key; order-only changes blocked for explicit initial-move review.
policy.forms: Literal learnset data only. Do not infer inheritance or choose one shared consumer's expectation over another.
policy.early_level: Require nonempty sorted 0..100 rows, <=50 rows, valid nonzero u16 move IDs, and an eligible move at level 1 before writing.
policy.low_level_coverage: All active pointer targets checked conservatively at L1, stronger than normal encounters; no claim that every form is encounterable.
policy.ability_semantics: Existing CFRU/DPE only; reviewed aliases retained, blocked/ignored/missing/ambiguous assignments never written.
policy.active_learnsets: CFRU src/Tables/level_up_learnsets.c only; DPE EXPAND_LEARNSETS is disabled
